{{one source |date=May 2024}}
In algebra, a '''simplicial Lie algebra''' is a [[simplicial object]] in the category of [[Lie algebra]]s. In particular, it is a [[simplicial abelian group]], and thus is subject to the [[Dold–Kan correspondence]].
